name: GPU Reset & Gluon All-Gather Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  test-gluon-all-gather:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    # Ensure the runner has ROCm GPUs available (e.g., MI325X)
    if: github.repository == 'ROCm/iris'
    
    env:
      ROCM_PATH: /opt/rocm
      PATH: /opt/rocm/bin:$PATH
      LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /opt/rocm/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
      HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES: 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7
      NCCL_DEBUG: INFO
      NCCL_ALGO: Tree
      NCCL_PROTO: Simple

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          architecture: 'x64'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pytest-xdist
          # Install iris package in editable mode
          pip install -e .
          # Ensure torch and triton are compatible with ROCm
          pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm6.0
          pip install triton

      - name: Reset GPU State
        run: |
          # Reset GPU state to ensure clean environment for tests
          echo "Resetting GPU state..."
          # Optional: Run a simple kernel to warm up/reset if necessary
          python -c "import torch; torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()"

      - name: Run Gluon All-Gather Tests
        run: |
          # Run tests using torchrun for multi-GPU support (8 GPUs)
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 \
            -m pytest \
            tests/test_all_gather_gluon.py \
            -v \
            --tb=short \
            -x

      - name: Run Regression Tests (Triton All-Gather)
        run: |
          # Verify no regression on existing Triton all-gather tests
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 \
            -m pytest \
            tests/test_all_gather_triton.py \
            -v \
            --tb=short \
            -x

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Clean up any lingering processes
          pkill -9 python || true
          pkill -9 torchrun || true
